issue.title: Error installing CLI on Linux
issue.body:
Hey Peter, thanks for building Pushin!

I tried to use the install script on my Fedora Linux on `bash`, and got the following error:

```sh
$ PUN_VERSION=0.2.7

case "$(uname -m)" in
  x86_64)        PUN_PLATFORM=linux-x86_64 ;;
  aarch64|arm64) PUN_PLATFORM=linux-arm64 ;;
  *) echo "unsupported CPU architecture: $(uname -m)" >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac

PUN_TMP_DIR="$(mktemp -d)"
PUN_ARCHIVE="pushin-cli-v${PUN_VERSION}/dist/${PUN_PLATFORM}/pun"

curl -fsSL \
  "https://pushin.eu/pjullrich/pushin-cli/archive/v${PUN_VERSION}.tar.gz" \
  -o "$PUN_TMP_DIR/pushin-cli.tar.gz"
tar -xzf "$PUN_TMP_DIR/pushin-cli.tar.gz" \
  -C "$PUN_TMP_DIR" --strip-components=3 "$PUN_ARCHIVE"
sudo install -m 0755 "$PUN_TMP_DIR/pun" /usr/local/bin/pun
rm -r "$PUN_TMP_DIR"

pun --version
curl: (22) The requested URL returned error: 404
tar (child): /tmp/tmp.l0M7Dn5HBF/pushin-cli.tar.gz: Cannot open: No such file or directory
tar (child): Error is not recoverable: exiting now
tar: Child returned status 2
tar: Error is not recoverable: exiting now
install: cannot stat '/tmp/tmp.l0M7Dn5HBF/pun': No such file or directory
bash: pun: command not found...
```

The root cause seems to be the invalid `PUN_VERSION=0.2.7` version.

Looking at https://pushin.eu/pjullrich/pushin-cli-tap/blob/main/Formula/pun.rb I can see the version distributed there is `0.2.6`.

But changing the `PUN_VERSION` to `0.2.6` still has an issue:

```sh
$ PUN_VERSION=0.2.6
case "$(uname -m)" in
  x86_64)        PUN_PLATFORM=linux-x86_64 ;;
  aarch64|arm64) PUN_PLATFORM=linux-arm64 ;;
  *) echo "Unsupported CPU architecture: $(uname -m)" >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac

PUN_TMP_DIR="$(mktemp -d)"
curl -fsSL "https://pushin.eu/pjullrich/pushin-cli/archive/v${PUN_VERSION}.tar.gz" -o "$PUN_TMP_DIR/pun.tar.gz"
tar -xzf "$PUN_TMP_DIR/pun.tar.gz" -C "$PUN_TMP_DIR" --strip-components=3 "pushin-cli-v${PUN_VERSION}/dist/${PUN_PLATFORM}/pun"
sudo install -m 0755 "$PUN_TMP_DIR/pun" /usr/local/bin/pun
rm -r "$PUN_TMP_DIR"
pun --version
tar: pushin-cli-v0.2.6/dist/linux-x86_64/pun: Not found in archive
tar: Exiting with failure status due to previous errors
Place your finger on the fingerprint reader
install: cannot stat '/tmp/tmp.iulCLKfGhl/pun': No such file or directory
bash: pun: command not found...
```

Looking at the Tar file I don't see the required `pushin-cli-v0.2.6/dist/linux-x86_64/pun` path the script expects (only MacOS binaries there):

```sh
$ tar zxvf pun.tar.gz
pushin-cli-v0.2.6/
pushin-cli-v0.2.6/.gitignore
pushin-cli-v0.2.6/.tool-versions
pushin-cli-v0.2.6/Cargo.lock

pushin-cli-v0.2.6/tests/http.rs

pushin-cli-v0.2.6/tests/org.rs
pushin-cli-v0.2.6/tests/set_origin.rs
pushin-cli-v0.2.6/tests/update.rs
```

So it seems that there's two problems: the `pun` CLI `v0.2.7` isn't available via the `archives` URL, and it isn't being distributed to MacOS users via Homebrew :)

items.title: ﻿nix flake doesnt have an aarch64-darwin package so doesnt work on my mac
items.body:
the repo actually has a mac binary but the flake doesnt include it. 

proposed fix:
```diff
diff --git a/.github/workflows/nix.yml b/.github/workflows/nix.yml
--- a/.github/workflows/nix.yml
+++ b/.github/workflows/nix.yml
@@ -21,4 +21,5 @@ jobs:
         run: |
           nix eval --raw .#packages.x86_64-linux.pun.drvPath
           nix eval --raw .#packages.aarch64-linux.pun.drvPath
+          nix eval --raw .#packages.aarch64-darwin.pun.drvPath
           nix flake check --no-build --all-systems
diff --git a/README.md b/README.md
--- a/README.md
+++ b/README.md
@@ -50,7 +50,8 @@ yay -S pushin-cli-bin
 #### Nix / NixOS

 The flake packages the checked-in, static Linux binary for `x86_64-linux` or
-`aarch64-linux` (no Rust compilation). To run it once without installing:
+`aarch64-linux`, and macOS binary for `aarch64-darwin` (no Rust
+compilation). To run it once without installing:

 ```sh
 nix run 'git+https://git.pushin.eu/pjullrich/pushin-cli.git#pun' -- --version
diff --git a/flake.nix b/flake.nix
--- a/flake.nix
+++ b/flake.nix
@@ -24,6 +24,7 @@
       systems = [
         "x86_64-linux"
         "aarch64-linux"
+        "aarch64-darwin"
       ];
       lib = nixpkgs.lib;
       toolVersions = builtins.listToAttrs (
diff --git a/nix/package.nix b/nix/package.nix
--- a/nix/package.nix
+++ b/nix/package.nix
@@ -9,6 +9,7 @@ let
     {
       x86_64-linux = "linux-x86_64";
       aarch64-linux = "linux-arm64";
+      aarch64-darwin = "macos-universal";
     }
     .${stdenvNoCC.hostPlatform.system}
       or (throw "pun: unsupported platform ${stdenvNoCC.hostPlatform.system}");
@@ -46,6 +47,7 @@ stdenvNoCC.mkDerivation {
     platforms = [
       "x86_64-linux"
       "aarch64-linux"
+      "aarch64-darwin"
     ];
     sourceProvenance = [ lib.sourceTypes.binaryNativeCode ];
   };
```

just fyi, cant do intel mac support because nixpkgs dropped support for that. just in case you were wondering.

cant open PR for this because of issue #10 i filed. happy to submit once i can fork.
